name: Penny
bio: I will be going into 11th grade this year and I am interested in environmentalism because I hope we are able to maintain a live-able earth for everyone to live on for as long as possible. I’ve learned about ways I could live more sustainably, and I’ve participated in beach/park cleanups. My goals for this organization is for it to be able to teach people how important it is to care about the impact that they leave on their environments and how they could make small changes to help.
